# British IPTV

> British IPTV (iptv-british.com) is an IPTV UK subscription service: 50,000+ live TV channels and 200,000+ movies and series on demand, streamed in up to 4K over broadband to Smart TVs, Amazon Firestick, Android, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, MAG boxes, Windows and Mac. No contract, no dish, free 3-hour trial.

## Key facts

- Service type: IPTV subscription for UK viewers (also works abroad)
- Live channels: 50,000+ (UK and international entertainment, sport, movies, news, kids, music)
- On demand: 200,000+ movies and series
- Quality: SD, HD, FHD and 4K
- Features: 7-day catch-up, electronic programme guide (EPG), Anti-Freeze technology, 24/7 WhatsApp support
- Prices (1 device): 1 month £15 · 3 months £35 · 6 months £45 · 12 months £60 (£5/month) · 24 months £110
- Extra connections: 1 to 4 devices per subscription
- Free trial: 3 hours, no credit card, activated via WhatsApp
- Recommended broadband: 10 Mbps for HD, 25 Mbps for 4K
- Compatible apps: TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV, any M3U / Xtream Codes player
- Contact: WhatsApp +212 707 711 512 · goldengateiptv@gmail.com
